text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "The parties to this agreement are Dassault Systemes, a societe anonyme organized under the laws of France and the owner of Purchaser, and PARTY_1 (formerly known as PARTY_2), a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Delaware.","citations": [{"chunk_id": "C1", "quote": "by and between Dassault Systemes, a societe anonyme organized under the laws of France and the owner of Purchaser (\"Dassault Systemes\") and/or certain affiliates of Dassault Systemes, and PARTY_1 (formerly known as PARTY_2), a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Delaware (\"PARTY_1\") (each a \"Party,\" together, the \"Parties\")."}]}
